<!DOCTYPE html>

<html lang="vi">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1" name="viewport"/>
<meta content="light" name="color-scheme"/>
<title>Mộc Thanh — Landing Page Desktop hoàn chỉnh | Tấm tiêu âm từ lõi ngô</title>
<meta content="Mộc Thanh — Hero toàn màn hình, câu chuyện không gian và khu trưng bày tương tác tấm tiêu âm từ lõi ngô." name="description"/>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" rel="preconnect"/>
<link crossorigin="" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" rel="preconnect"/>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&amp;family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;1,400;1,500&amp;display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
<style>
:root{--egg:#EDE7DB;--linen:#DDCCB7;--moss:#6A6A53;--olive:#9B9879;--mahogany:#4D342D;--line:rgba(77,52,45,.18);--ink:#392C25}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:var(--egg);font-family:'DM Sans',Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
button,a{font:inherit}
button{cursor:pointer}
a{text-decoration:none;color:inherit}
.hero{position:relative;height:100svh;min-height:710px;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;background:#b3a08e}
.scene{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-4}
.scene img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 45%;transition:opacity .65s ease;pointer-events:none}
.scene img.alt{opacity:0}
.hero[data-scene="2"] .scene img.base{opacity:0}
.hero[data-scene="2"] .scene img.alt{opacity:1}
/* Gradient light wash: full-bleed photograph, softened ONLY under the left text. */
.wash{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-3;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(247,241,232,1) 0%,rgba(247,241,232,1) 38%,rgba(247,241,232,.92) 46%,rgba(232,220,202,.35) 62%,rgba(232,220,202,0) 82%);transition:background .45s ease}
.wash::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;backdrop-filter:blur(7px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(7px);mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#000 0%,#000 34%,transparent 66%);-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#000 0%,#000 34%,transparent 66%)}
.wash::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(38,27,21,.38) 0%,transparent 16%,transparent 85%,rgba(30,26,20,.1));opacity:.55;pointer-events:none}
.hero[data-tone="dark"] .wash{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(43,31,27,.96) 0%,rgba(52,38,32,.93) 20%,rgba(60,43,36,.83) 38%,rgba(61,42,35,.48) 54%,transparent 78%)}
.hero[data-tone="dark"]{--ink:#fff9ef;--moss:#d4c7a9;--line:rgba(255,255,255,.24)}
.header{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:10;padding:0 max(5vw,56px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);height:92px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;color:var(--ink)}
.logo-box{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;min-width:300px}.logo-box img{width:auto;height:66px;max-width:150px;object-fit:contain;filter:none}
.hero[data-tone="dark"] .logo-box img{filter:brightness(0) invert(1)}
.header-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:34px}
.header-tag{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.25em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.77;white-space:nowrap}
.header-action{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;padding:12px 0;border:0;background:none;color:inherit;border-bottom:1px solid currentColor}
.hero-copy{position:absolute;left:max(5vw,56px);top:51.5%;width:min(700px,56vw);transform:translateY(-50%);z-index:5;color:var(--ink)}
.overline{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;margin-bottom:22px;color:var(--moss);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:12px;line-height:1.7}
.overline:before{content:"";width:32px;height:1px;background:currentColor}
h1{font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(55px,5.55vw,89px);letter-spacing:-.047em;line-height:1.095;margin:0 0 29px;max-width:850px}
h1 .line{display:block;overflow:hidden;padding-bottom:.08em}
h1 em{display:inline;color:var(--moss);font-weight:400}
.lead{font-size:16px;line-height:1.95;max-width:470px;margin:0 0 33px;color:var(--ink);opacity:.77}
.actions{display:flex;gap:23px;align-items:center}
.primary{appearance:none;background:var(--mahogany);border:1px solid var(--mahogany);border-radius:2px;color:#fff;padding:18px 27px;min-width:215px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.01em;transition:transform .25s,background .25s}
.primary:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);background:#60443a}
.hero[data-tone="dark"] .primary{background:var(--egg);color:#4D342D;border-color:var(--egg)}
.text-action{border:0;background:none;padding:17px 0;border-bottom:1px solid currentColor;color:var(--ink);font-size:13px;font-weight:600}
.foot-left{position:absolute;left:max(5vw,56px);bottom:43px;z-index:5;display:flex;gap:19px;align-items:center;color:var(--ink);font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase}
.foot-left .line-scroll{width:70px;height:1px;background:currentColor;opacity:.55}
.preview-controls{position:absolute;right:max(5vw,56px);bottom:36px;z-index:6;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
.scene-controls{display:flex;gap:7px;padding:5px;background:rgba(35,30,25,.38);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);border-radius:999px}
.scene-controls button{width:39px;height:35px;border-radius:100px;border:0;color:#fff;background:transparent;font-weight:700;font-size:12px}
.scene-controls button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:#fff;color:#4D342D}
.preview-caption{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase}
.demo-toolbar{position:absolute;top:116px;right:max(5vw,56px);z-index:8;display:flex;gap:8px}
.mode{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.45);color:#fff;background:rgba(50,37,31,.4);padding:10px 14px;border-radius:20px;backdrop-filter:blur(9px);font-size:12px}
.mode[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--egg);border-color:var(--egg);color:var(--mahogany)}
.watermark{position:absolute;right:max(5vw,56px);bottom:91px;z-index:5;color:white;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.07em;text-shadow:0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.dialog{border:0;padding:0;width:min(1000px,92vw);max-height:min(810px,89vh);background:#f5efe7;color:var(--mahogany);border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 40px 120px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.dialog::backdrop{background:rgba(27,22,18,.65);backdrop-filter:blur(7px)}
.dialog-inner{padding:32px 36px 28px}
.dialog-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:start;gap:24px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(77,52,45,.17);padding-bottom:20px}
.dialog h2{font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;font-size:40px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.1;margin:7px 0 0}
.dialog small{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--moss)}
.close{border:1px solid rgba(77,52,45,.2);background:#fff;width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:100%;font-size:25px;color:var(--mahogany)}
.dialog-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:32px;padding-top:27px}
.product-stage{background:#eae0d2;min-height:480px;display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:hidden;border-radius:4px}
.product-stage img{height:480px;max-width:100%;object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(10px 18px 12px rgba(50,33,23,.08))}
.product-info h3{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-weight:500;font-size:34px;margin:0 0 8px}
.product-info p{line-height:1.75;color:#76685a;margin:0 0 18px;font-size:14px}
.product-meta{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.15em;color:#6A6A53;text-transform:uppercase;border-block:1px solid rgba(77,52,45,.15);padding:14px 0;margin:20px 0}
.finishes{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}
.finish{border:1px solid rgba(77,52,45,.14);background:#fff;padding:8px;border-radius:4px;text-align:left;color:#4D342D;transition:border-color .2s}
.finish[aria-pressed="true"]{border:2px solid var(--moss)}
.finish img{width:100%;height:60px;object-fit:cover;object-position:center;border-radius:3px}
.finish span{display:block;font-size:11px;margin-top:6px}
.notice{padding-top:20px;font-size:12px;color:#76685a;line-height:1.7}
@media (min-width:1700px){.hero-copy{width:790px}.lead{font-size:18px}}
@media (max-width:1200px){.hero-copy{width:690px;max-width:65vw}h1{font-size:60px}.header{padding-inline:40px}.hero-copy,.foot-left{left:40px}.preview-controls,.watermark,.demo-toolbar{right:40px}}
@media (max-width:880px){.hero{min-height:650px}.header{height:80px}.header-tag{display:none}.hero-copy{width:calc(100% - 60px);max-width:650px;left:30px}.header{padding:0 30px}h1{font-size:52px}.lead{max-width:440px}.wash{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(247,241,232,.98),rgba(247,241,232,.75) 65%,rgba(247,241,232,.25))}.preview-controls,.demo-toolbar,.watermark{right:24px}.foot-left{left:30px}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*:before,*:after{animation-duration:.01ms!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}}

/* ========================================================
  SECTION 02 — KHÔNG GIAN & ÂM THANH
  Editorial architecture chapter; intentionally NOT another hero.
  All images stay visible without JavaScript.
======================================================== */
.acoustic-section{background:#f5f0e8;color:#3f3028;position:relative;isolation:isolate;overflow:clip}
.acoustic-section .as-container{width:min(1420px,calc(100% - 10.4vw));margin:0 auto}
.acoustic-section .as-intro{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(210px,.32fr) minmax(0,1fr);column-gap:clamp(50px,6.4vw,120px);padding:clamp(100px,10.4vw,165px) 0 76px;align-items:start}
.as-kicker{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;padding-top:19px;color:#6A6A53;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.18em;line-height:1.6;text-transform:uppercase}
.as-kicker::before{content:'';width:42px;height:1px;background:#9B9879;flex:none}
.as-copy h2{font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(58px,5.4vw,88px);line-height:1.11;letter-spacing:-.05em;font-weight:400;margin:0 0 27px;max-width:1030px;color:#49362d}
.as-copy h2 em{font-weight:400;color:#6A6A53}
.as-lead{max-width:720px;font-size:clamp(16px,1.3vw,19px);line-height:1.82;color:#6e645b;margin:0;font-weight:400}
.as-figure{position:relative;margin:0 2.6vw;overflow:hidden;background:#d3c7b9;isolation:isolate;}
.as-frame{position:relative;width:100%;height:clamp(510px,56vw,770px);overflow:hidden;background:#d4c5b4;clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0);will-change:clip-path}
.as-image{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 47%;transform:scale(1);will-change:transform;display:block}
.as-frame:after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(38,28,23,.58),rgba(39,31,25,0) 33%);pointer-events:none}
.as-figure-overlay{position:absolute;bottom:36px;left:clamp(24px,4.5vw,76px);right:clamp(24px,4.5vw,76px);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:24px;color:#fff;z-index:2}
.as-figure-overlay .as-image-title{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:clamp(26px,2.2vw,40px);margin:0 0 6px;line-height:1.18;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.02em;text-shadow:0 1px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.15)}
.as-figure-overlay .as-image-meta{font-size:12px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.2em;font-weight:600;opacity:.95;margin:0}
.as-figure-overlay .as-image-index{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;white-space:nowrap}
.as-caption{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:36px;align-items:baseline;margin:0;padding:13px 2px 0;color:#8a8074;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6}
.as-caption span:last-child{text-align:right}
.as-conclusion{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(210px,.32fr) minmax(0,1fr);column-gap:clamp(50px,6.4vw,120px);padding:clamp(86px,9vw,140px) 0 clamp(80px,9vw,138px);align-items:start}
.as-micro{padding-top:12px;color:#6A6A53;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1.9}
.as-meaning{max-width:1060px}
.as-meaning .as-statement{font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;color:#49362d;font-size:clamp(38px,3.5vw,59px);font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.035em;line-height:1.22;margin:0 0 30px}
.as-meaning .as-statement em{color:#6A6A53;font-weight:400}
.as-meaning .as-detail{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:40px;border-top:1px solid rgba(77,52,45,.24);padding-top:24px}
.as-detail p{font-size:15px;line-height:1.85;color:#74695f;margin:0}
.as-detail strong{color:#49362d;font-weight:600}
.as-next{border-top:1px solid rgba(77,52,45,.18);padding:26px 0 32px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;color:#6A6A53;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:700}
.as-next i{display:block;width:78px;height:1px;background:#9B9879}
@media (max-width:1300px){.acoustic-section .as-container{width:calc(100% - 100px)}.acoustic-section .as-intro,.as-conclusion{grid-template-columns:210px 1fr;gap:44px}.as-copy h2{font-size:63px}.as-statement{font-size:46px}}
@media (max-width:900px){.acoustic-section .as-container{width:calc(100% - 56px)}.acoustic-section .as-intro,.as-conclusion{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:18px}.as-copy h2{font-size:clamp(44px,7vw,66px)}.as-frame{height:60vh;min-height:450px}.as-figure{margin:0 18px}.as-meaning .as-detail{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:14px}.as-caption span:last-child{display:none}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.as-image,.as-frame{will-change:auto!important}}


/* SECTION 03 / Product-Centric Architectural Editorial, scoped to ps- classes. */
.ps-section{background:#ebe4d9;color:#42332c;position:relative;isolation:isolate;overflow:clip}
.ps-shell{width:min(1400px,calc(100% - 8.5vw));margin:0 auto}
.ps-chapter-head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;column-gap:7%;padding:clamp(98px,9.5vw,160px) 0 64px;align-items:end}
.ps-kicker{grid-column:1/-1;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.2em;font-weight:700;color:#6A6A53;margin:0 0 28px}
.ps-index{font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;font-size:30px;letter-spacing:0;font-weight:400}
.ps-kicker-rule{width:50px;height:1px;background:#9B9879}
.ps-chapter-head h2{font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(66px,6vw,100px);line-height:1.04;letter-spacing:-.058em;font-weight:400;margin:0}
.ps-chapter-head h2 em{color:#6A6A53;font-weight:400}
.ps-chapter-intro{max-width:410px;margin:0 0 9px auto;font-size:18px;line-height:1.87;color:#766b60}
.ps-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.06fr) minmax(0,.94fr);gap:clamp(38px,5.2vw,84px);align-items:start;padding-bottom:120px}
.ps-gallery{min-width:0;align-self:stretch;position:relative}
.ps-gallery-sticky{position:sticky;top:28px;max-width:670px}
.ps-visual-surface{height:min(74vh,710px);min-height:560px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#f6f1e9;border:1px solid rgba(77,52,45,.09)}
.ps-visual-surface img{height:100%;width:100%;object-fit:contain;object-position:50% 49%;display:block}
.ps-visual-top,.ps-visual-bottom{position:absolute;display:flex;left:24px;right:24px;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;z-index:2;color:#827466;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.16em;font-weight:700;line-height:1.4}
.ps-visual-top{top:22px}.ps-visual-bottom{bottom:22px}
.ps-gallery-caption{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:25px;align-items:end;padding:22px 3px 18px}
.ps-gallery-caption div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.ps-gallery-caption strong{font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;font-size:27px;font-weight:400;color:#49362d}
.ps-gallery-caption span{font-size:12px;color:#7e7368;line-height:1.5}
.ps-gallery-caption>span{text-align:right;max-width:220px}
.ps-gallery-progress{height:2px;background:rgba(77,52,45,.15)}.ps-gallery-progress span{height:100%;width:0;display:block;background:#6A6A53}
.ps-details{min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0}
.ps-overline{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;font-weight:700;color:#6A6A53;line-height:1.6}
.ps-lede-block{padding:16px 0 46px}
.ps-lede-block h3{font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(32px,2.8vw,45px);line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.035em;margin:22px 0 18px}
.ps-lede-block p{margin:0;font-size:16px;line-height:1.87;color:#766b60;max-width:510px}
.ps-detail-group{border-top:1px solid rgba(77,52,45,.19);padding:34px 0 43px}
.ps-detail-heading{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:baseline;margin:0 0 24px}
.ps-detail-num{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#6A6A53}.ps-detail-heading h4{font-size:19px;font-weight:600;margin:0;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.ps-size-select{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}
.ps-size{padding:16px 10px;text-align:center;background:transparent;border:1px solid rgba(77,52,45,.21);color:#49362d;transition:.22s;cursor:pointer}
.ps-size:hover,.ps-size:focus-visible{background:#eee5d8;border-color:#6A6A53}.ps-size.is-active{background:#4D342D;color:white;border-color:#4D342D}
.ps-size span{display:block;font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;font-size:29px;line-height:1.1;margin-bottom:3px}.ps-size small{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.02em;opacity:.8}
.ps-helper{font-size:12px;line-height:1.85;color:#807467;margin:18px 0 0}.ps-helper strong{color:#49362d;font-weight:600}
.ps-finishes{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}
.ps-finish{min-width:0;padding:9px 9px 14px;text-align:left;border:1px solid rgba(77,52,45,.15);background:#f2ebe2;color:#49362d;cursor:pointer;transition:background .18s,border-color .18s,transform .18s}
.ps-finish:hover,.ps-finish:focus-visible{border-color:#6A6A53;background:#faf6ee}.ps-finish.is-active{border-color:#4D342D;background:#fffaf2;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #4D342D}
.ps-finish-thumb{display:block;height:118px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;position:relative;margin-bottom:11px}
.ps-finish-thumb img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain}
.ps-finish-name{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.5}.ps-finish-vn{display:block;font-size:11px;color:#786b60;line-height:1.65}
.ps-mount-options{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
.ps-mount{padding:20px;background:transparent;border:1px solid rgba(77,52,45,.17);color:#49362d;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:11px;transition:.2s}
.ps-mount:hover{background:#f4eee5}.ps-mount.is-active{background:#f7f2ea;border-color:#6A6A53}
.ps-mount>span{font-size:11px;color:#6A6A53;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em}.ps-mount strong{font-size:16px;font-weight:600}.ps-mount small{font-size:12px;color:#7b6e61}
.ps-mount-text{margin:16px 0 0;color:#786c62;font-size:13px;line-height:1.85;min-height:72px}
.ps-study{background:#6A6A53;padding:26px 28px;color:#fff;margin-top:3px}.ps-study .ps-overline{color:#e7dfcb}
.ps-study>div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:18px;align-items:center;margin-top:15px}
.ps-study strong{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:43px;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.04em;white-space:nowrap}
.ps-study span:not(.ps-overline){font-size:12px;line-height:1.76;color:rgba(255,255,255,.86)}.ps-study b{font-weight:600;color:white}
.ps-story{border-top:1px solid rgba(77,52,45,.19);padding:90px 0 100px}
.ps-story-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:50px;align-items:end;margin-bottom:44px}
.ps-story-top h3{font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(45px,4.2vw,68px);line-height:1.12;letter-spacing:-.042em;font-weight:400;margin:18px 0 0}
.ps-story-top h3 em{color:#6A6A53;font-weight:400}
.ps-story-top>p{max-width:390px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.85;color:#786d62;margin:0}
.ps-story-images{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:28px}
.ps-story-card{margin:0;min-width:0}.ps-story-img{overflow:hidden;background:#d3c0a9}.ps-story-img img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:1.58/1;object-fit:cover;display:block;transition:transform .55s ease}
.ps-story-card:hover .ps-story-img img{transform:scale(1.02)}
.ps-story-card figcaption{padding:21px 4px}.ps-story-card figcaption>span{display:block;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.17em;color:#6A6A53;margin-bottom:10px}
.ps-story-card figcaption strong{display:block;font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;font-weight:400;font-size:28px;color:#49362d}
.ps-story-card figcaption p{font-size:14px;line-height:1.82;color:#7c6f65;margin:12px 0 0;max-width:550px}
.ps-outro{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:30px;align-items:center;padding:25px 0 42px;border-top:1px solid rgba(77,52,45,.17);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.17em;font-weight:700;color:#6A6A53}
@media(max-width:1400px){.ps-shell{width:calc(100% - 100px)}.ps-chapter-head h2{font-size:74px}.ps-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:46px}.ps-visual-surface{height:630px;min-height:0}.ps-finish-thumb{height:105px}}
@media(max-width:1120px){.ps-shell{width:calc(100% - 64px)}.ps-chapter-head h2{font-size:65px}.ps-layout{gap:30px}.ps-visual-surface{height:550px}.ps-finishes{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.ps-gallery-sticky{top:18px}.ps-study>div{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:8px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ps-story-img img{transition:none!important}}

/* NEW SECTION 02–03: scoped style to avoid breaking original Hero and product scenes. */
.mtv-chapter, .mtc-section{position:relative;isolation:isolate;clear:both;width:100%;overflow:hidden;box-sizing:border-box}
.mtv-chapter *,.mtc-section *{box-sizing:border-box}
.mtv-shell,.mtc-shell{width:min(1340px,calc(100% - 110px));margin-inline:auto}
.mtv-panel{min-height:780px;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:100px 0}
.mtv-mission{background:#ede7db;color:#4d342d}
.mtv-vision{background:#f6f0e6;color:#4d342d;border-top:1px solid #d7cdbd}
.mtv-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.83fr) minmax(0,1.17fr);align-items:center;gap:clamp(45px,6vw,116px)}
.mtv-art{height:600px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.mtv-art img{max-height:100%;max-width:100%;width:auto;object-fit:contain;filter:saturate(.8);mix-blend-mode:multiply}
.mtv-kicker,.mtc-kicker{font-size:13px;font-weight:650;letter-spacing:.22em;color:#6a6a53;margin-bottom:28px}
.mtv-content h2,.mtc-top h2{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:clamp(56px,5.5vw,92px);font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.055em;line-height:1.08;margin:0 0 26px}
.mtv-content h2 em,.mtc-top h2 em{font-weight:400;color:#6a6a53}
.mtv-content p{font-size:clamp(16px,1.2vw,20px);line-height:1.9;max-width:710px;margin:0;color:#574c42}
.mtv-leafmark{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:100px;line-height:.9;color:#6a6a53}
.mtv-vision .mtv-grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.15fr) minmax(0,.85fr)}
.mtv-vision-graphic{min-height:550px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.mtv-vision-graphic img{height:560px;max-width:100%;width:auto;object-fit:contain;opacity:.28;filter:sepia(.4) saturate(.65)}
.mtc-section{background:#6a6a53;color:#f8f4ea;padding:125px 0 85px}
.mtc-top{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .68fr;align-items:end;gap:clamp(50px,8vw,150px);padding-bottom:80px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35)}
.mtc-kicker{color:#e5d8c6}
.mtc-top h2{margin-bottom:0;color:#f8f4ea}
.mtc-top h2 em{color:#e0d0b9}
.mtc-top p{font-size:clamp(17px,1.25vw,21px);line-height:1.95;margin:0 0 6px;color:#f1ebdf}
.mtc-values{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:34px;padding:66px 0 80px}
.mtc-value{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4);padding-top:24px}
.mtc-value>span{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:32px;color:#ddccb7}
.mtc-value h3{font-weight:500;font-size:23px;margin:26px 0 14px;line-height:1.35}
.mtc-value p{color:#e9e3d4;line-height:1.85;font-size:16px;margin:0}
.mtc-bottom{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);padding-top:26px;letter-spacing:.2em;font-size:12px;color:#f6f0e6}.mtc-bottom span{margin:0 8px}
@media(max-width:1400px){.mtv-panel{min-height:700px}.mtv-art{height:530px}.mtv-content h2,.mtc-top h2{font-size:clamp(54px,5vw,76px)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.mtv-chapter *, .mtc-section *{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}


/* V10 additions: all section styles scoped to .m10-* to avoid V9 collisions. */
.m10-section{position:relative;isolation:isolate;padding:112px 0;scroll-margin-top:92px;overflow:hidden}
.m10-shell{width:min(1320px,calc(100% - 112px));margin:0 auto}
.m10-smallline{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding-bottom:19px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(77,52,45,.22);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.18em;font-weight:700;color:#6A6A53}
.m10-section h2{font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;font-weight:400;line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.038em;font-size:clamp(54px,5vw,84px);margin:0;color:#392C25}
.m10-section h2 em{font-weight:400;color:#6A6A53}
.m10-section p{font-size:17px;line-height:1.9;color:#695c50;margin:0}
.m10-overline{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.24em;color:#6A6A53;font-weight:700}
.m10-origin{background:#EDE7DB}
.m10-origin-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.92fr) minmax(0,1.08fr);gap:7%;align-items:center;min-height:680px;padding-top:40px}
.m10-origin-copy{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:24px}
.m10-origin-copy h2{max-width:560px}
.m10-origin-copy p{max-width:540px}
.m10-origin-copy .m10-quiet{border-left:2px solid #9B9879;padding-left:16px;font-size:13px;color:#837466}
.m10-origin-image{margin:0;position:relative;aspect-ratio:1.08/1;overflow:hidden;background:#DDCCB7}
.m10-origin-image img{height:100%;width:100%;object-fit:cover}
.m10-origin-image figcaption{position:absolute;right:0;bottom:0;background:#EDE7DB;padding:12px 16px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.06em}
.m10-finishes{background:#f6f1e9}
.m10-heading-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.2fr) minmax(0,.65fr);gap:10%;align-items:end;margin:60px 0 58px}
.m10-heading-row p{padding-bottom:6px;max-width:490px}
.m10-finish-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}
.m10-finish-card{min-width:0}
.m10-finish-portrait{height:360px;background:#eee7db;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.m10-finish-portrait img{display:block;height:100%;width:100%;object-fit:contain}
.m10-finish-label{padding:16px 4px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(77,52,45,.2)}
.m10-finish-label b{font-size:14px;font-weight:600}.m10-finish-label span{font-size:12px;color:#74675b}
.m10-finish-foot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;margin-top:32px;color:#6A6A53;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em}
.m10-finish-foot a{color:#4D342D;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:5px}
.m10-price{background:#DDCCB7}
.m10-table-wrap{overflow-x:auto;border-top:1px solid rgba(77,52,45,.34);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(77,52,45,.34)}
.m10-pricetable{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;table-layout:fixed;text-align:left}
.m10-pricetable th,.m10-pricetable td{padding:23px 18px 23px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(77,52,45,.15);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.m10-pricetable tr:last-child th,.m10-pricetable tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none}
.m10-pricetable thead th{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;font-weight:700;color:#5D5948}
.m10-pricetable tbody th{font-size:16px;font-weight:600}.m10-pricetable tbody td{font-size:18px}
.m10-pricetable tbody tr:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.16)}
.m10-price-note{margin-top:21px!important;font-size:12px!important;line-height:1.7!important}
.m10-applications{background:#f5f0e8}
.m10-app-grid{display:grid;gap:96px}
.m10-app-card{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.07fr) minmax(0,.73fr);gap:7%;align-items:center}
.m10-app-card:nth-child(even){grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.73fr) minmax(0,1.07fr)}
.m10-app-card:nth-child(even) figure{order:2}.m10-app-card:nth-child(even) .m10-app-text{order:1}
.m10-app-card figure{margin:0;min-width:0}
.m10-app-card figure img{height:520px;width:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.m10-app-card figure figcaption{font-size:11px;color:#807366;padding-top:11px}
.m10-app-text{min-width:0}.m10-app-count{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.18em;color:#6A6A53}
.m10-app-text h3{font:400 clamp(42px,4vw,63px)/1.12 'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:-.03em;margin:28px 0 12px}
.m10-app-text h4{margin:0 0 22px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.18em;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6A6A53}
.m10-app-text p{max-width:480px}
.m10-connect{background:#4D342D;padding:130px 0 90px;color:#EDE7DB}
.m10-contact-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.4fr) minmax(0,.5fr);gap:12%;align-items:end}
.m10-connect h2{color:#EDE7DB;margin:55px 0 25px}
.m10-connect h2 em{color:#DDCCB7}
.m10-connect p{color:#E0D3C4;max-width:650px}
.m10-connect .m10-smallline{color:#DDCCB7;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.25)}
.m10-contact-link{display:inline-block;margin-top:48px;color:#EDE7DB;border-bottom:1px solid #DDCCB7;padding-bottom:12px;font-size:14px}
.m10-contact-side{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;padding:20px 0}
.m10-contact-side .m10-contact-rule{height:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.28);margin-bottom:20px}
.m10-contact-side span{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.17em;color:#C8B7A0}
.m10-contact-side strong{font:400 22px/1.25 'Playfair Display',serif;margin-bottom:18px}
.m10-contact-side p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.7}
@media (max-width:1450px){.m10-shell{width:calc(100% - 100px)}.m10-finish-portrait{height:310px}.m10-app-card figure img{height:450px}}
@media (max-width:1200px){.m10-shell{width:calc(100% - 80px)}.m10-finish-grid{gap:8px}.m10-finish-portrait{height:270px}.m10-app-grid{gap:70px}.m10-app-card figure img{height:400px}.m10-section{padding:92px 0}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.m10-section *, .m10-section *::before,.m10-section *::after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}

.m10-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:24px;margin-left:auto;padding-right:28px}.m10-nav a{font:600 12px/1.3 'DM Sans',Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.03em;color:#4D342D;white-space:nowrap}.m10-nav a:hover{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:5px}@media(max-width:1360px){.m10-nav{gap:14px;padding-right:10px}.m10-nav a{font-size:11px}}

.m10-origin-copy,.m10-origin-image,.m10-heading-row,.m10-finish-card,.m10-app-card,.m10-contact-grid{opacity:1;transform:none}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.m10-in{animation:m10FadeIn .8s both}@keyframes m10FadeIn{from{opacity:.7;transform:translateY(13px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}}


.m10-heading-row{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.08fr) minmax(0,.62fr) minmax(240px,.42fr);align-items:start}
.m10-heading-row .m10-price-accent{margin:0;align-self:start;justify-self:end;width:min(100%,280px);background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);border:1px solid rgba(77,52,45,.14);padding:10px;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 16px 34px rgba(77,52,45,.08)}
.m10-heading-row .m10-price-accent img{display:block;width:100%;height:180px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:10px}
.m10-heading-row .m10-price-accent figcaption{margin-top:8px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6A6A53;font-weight:700}
@media (max-width: 1180px){.m10-heading-row{grid-template-columns:1fr}.m10-heading-row .m10-price-accent{justify-self:start;width:min(100%,340px)} }

/* V17: Product detail images intentionally continue after the new pricing table. */
.ps-continuation{padding-top:72px;padding-bottom:92px;background:#f5f0e8}
.ps-continuation .ps-shell{max-width:1320px;margin:0 auto}
.ps-continuation .ps-story{margin-top:0}
.ps-continuation .ps-outro{margin-top:55px}
</style>

<body><section aria-label="Hero Mộc Thanh" class="hero" data-scene="1" data-tone="light" id="hero">
<div aria-hidden="true" class="scene">
<img alt="Không gian họp sử dụng các tấm tiêu âm Mộc Thanh trong bảng màu trung tính và vân gỗ" class="base" id="livingImage" src="data:image/webp;base64,"/>
</div>
<div class="wash"></div>
<header class="header">
<a aria-label="Mộc Thanh — đầu trang" class="logo-box" href="#hero"><img alt="Logo Mộc Thanh" src="data:image/png;base64,"/></a>
<div class="header-right">
<a class="header-action" href="#san-pham">Khám phá sản phẩm  ↗</a>
</div>
<nav aria-label="Điều hướng các section" class="m10-nav"><a href="#tam-nhin">Về Mộc Thanh</a><a href="#san-pham">Sản phẩm</a><a href="#bang-gia">Bảng giá</a><a href="#ung-dung">Ứng dụng</a></nav></header>
<div class="hero-copy">
<h1><span class="line">Lan tỏa giá trị xanh,</span><span class="line"><em>nâng tầm</em> không gian sống.</span></h1>
<p class="lead">Nội thất tinh tế từ phụ phẩm thiên nhiên.<br/>Mộc mạc trong chất liệu, thanh lịch trong đường nét</p>
<div class="actions"><a aria-label="Khám phá sản phẩm Mộc Thanh" class="primary" href="#san-pham">Khám phá sản phẩm <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></div>
</div>
<div class="foot-left"><span>01 / MỘC THANH</span><span class="line-scroll"></span><span>CUỘN XUỐNG ĐỂ KHÁM PHÁ</span></div>
</section><section aria-label="Mục tiêu và tầm nhìn" class="mtv-chapter" id="tam-nhin">
<div class="mtv-mission mtv-panel">
<div class="mtv-shell mtv-grid">
<div aria-hidden="true" class="mtv-art"><img alt="Lõi ngô khô đã tách hạt trên nền vải tự nhiên" src="data:image/webp;base64,"/></div>
<div class="mtv-content"><div class="mtv-kicker">02 / MỤC TIÊU — MISSION</div><h2>Một bước đi từ <em>giá trị tự nhiên.</em></h2><div aria-hidden="true" class="mtv-leafmark">“</div><p>Mộc Thanh hướng đến nghiên cứu và phát triển giải pháp tiêu âm từ lõi ngô nhằm giảm tiếng ồn, hạn chế tiếng vang trong không gian sống và làm việc. Thông qua việc tận dụng phụ phẩm nông nghiệp, dự án mong muốn tạo ra vật liệu tiêu âm có nguồn gốc tự nhiên, thân thiện với môi trường, góp phần thay thế một phần các vật liệu tiêu âm từ nhựa tổng hợp và nâng cao giá trị sử dụng của nguồn nguyên liệu nông nghiệp sẵn có.</p></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mtv-vision mtv-panel"><div class="mtv-shell mtv-grid">
<div class="mtv-content"><div class="mtv-kicker">TẦM NHÌN — VISION</div><h2>Những khả năng <em>trong tương lai.</em></h2><p>Mộc Thanh định hướng trở thành thương hiệu tiên phong tại Việt Nam trong lĩnh vực vật liệu tiêu âm xanh từ phụ phẩm nông nghiệp. Trong dài hạn, dự án mong muốn mở rộng quy mô sản xuất, đa dạng hóa sản phẩm và đưa vật liệu tiêu âm sinh học trở thành một lựa chọn phổ biến trong các công trình dân dụng và thương mại, góp phần thúc đẩy xu hướng xây dựng xanh và kinh tế tuần hoàn.</p></div>
<div aria-hidden="true" class="mtv-vision-graphic"><img alt="Cận cảnh cấu trúc tổ ong của lõi ngô khô" src="data:image/png;base64,
